tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search verified businesses in the Spotby registry by free text, city and/or category. Returns compact results; use get_business for full details.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full profile of one business: identity, description, services with prices, weekly hours (all time ranges), contacts, photos with AI descriptions, FAQs, synced products, declared freshness.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Businesses whose data changed since a given moment — the freshness feed. Use it to stay in sync without re-crawling.
